chiSiamo.subtitle: A family-run hospitality that allows maximum attention to the guest.

story.title: Our Story
story.paragraph1: 3 Amici Suites was born from the desire to offer hospitality in a simple, curated and personal way. It all started with Pietro, Dario and Carlo who inherited their grandfather's old studio and decided to give new life to his work. This is how our first property was born: 3 Amici Suites.
story.paragraph2: Over the years we have expanded more and more thanks to the good work done with passion and sacrifice, just as our grandfather would have dreamed.
story.paragraph3: Over the years our idea of a stay combines comfort, attention to detail and an authentic relationship with Verona. We don't promise excess: we prefer to be concrete, reliable and present.

logo.title: The Logo Story
logo.text: The logo was created by a Veronese artist who wanted to represent the 3 friends (actually grandsons) as 3 arches reminiscent of the nearby Verona Arena. The design is simple and unique, just like your experience at our properties.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy describes how 3 Amici Suites collects, uses and protects personal data of users who visit www.3amicisuites.it and use our services.

controller.title: Data Controller
controller.content: 3 Amici Suites, based in Verona, Italy. Email: treamici.cadapi@gmail.com.

dataCollected.title: Data collected
items: Data voluntarily provided via the contact form (name, email, phone, message).
Browsing data collected automatically (IP address, browser type, pages visited) via technical cookies.
Booking-related data if you use our availability checker (selected dates, property of interest).

purpose.title: Purpose of processing
items: Respond to requests submitted via the contact form.
Check property availability for the requested dates.
Improve the browsing experience on the site.

legalBasis.title: Legal basis
legalBasis.content: Processing is based on the legitimate interest of the controller to respond to user requests and provide the requested services (Art. 6(1)(b) and (f) GDPR).

thirdParties.title: Third parties
thirdParties.content: We use Resend for email delivery (a third-party service based in the US, compliant with the EU-US Data Privacy Framework). For availability checks we consult Booking.com iCal feeds. No data is sold to third parties for commercial purposes.

retention.title: Data retention
retention.content: Data provided via the contact form is retained for the time necessary to respond to the request and, in case of booking, for contractual and tax obligations required by law.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.content: You have the right to access, rectify, delete, restrict processing, object to processing, and request portability of your data. To exercise these rights, write to treamici.cadapi@gmail.com.
rights.complaint: If you believe processing violates the GDPR, you have the right to lodge a complaint with the Italian Data Protection Authority (www.garanteprivacy.it).

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.content: This site only uses technical cookies necessary for operation and, with your consent, any analytics cookies. You can manage your preferences at any time by clicking the 'Cookies' button in the footer.

updates.title: Policy updates
updates.content: This Privacy Policy may be updated periodically. Changes will be published on this page.
